personality_one_liner: A sleek, sharp, command-center interface designed for instant operational clarity and hardware integration.

spacing.rule: Keep spacing tight and structural. Use md (12) for inner component padding and xl (24) between major sections.

do's: Use solid surface colors and sharp dividers to maintain high contrast and a hardware feel.
dont's: No blur or glassmorphism on this app. Clarity and utility beat aesthetics here.

screens.name: ControlPanel
screens.purpose: A single command-center screen to connect to the matrix and sync configurations.

states.loading: Centered brandPrimary activity indicator with 'Initializing Device...' text in Rajdhani.
states.empty: Not applicable as this is a static settings form with defaults.
states.error: Full screen error state: 'Connection lost' with a Retry button.

screens.layout: Root is a safe-area view. Top has an image-backed hero section with gradient scrim, housing the Connect button and status pill. Below is a ScrollView with three sections (Flight Tracking, Sports, TV Shows) separated by sharp dividers. The bottom has a sticky container for the Sync Settings button.

hero_led_matrix.alt: Abstract orange LED matrix honeycomb pattern

instructions_to_main_agent: Strict Typography Weight: Never use font weights above 500 (no SemiBold, Bold, etc). Rely on Rajdhani's condensed nature and larger sizes (xl/2xl) for hierarchy.
Banned Colors: Under no circumstances should any blue, indigo, purple, or violet be used. We are strictly adhering to the Ember (brand) + Obsidian (surface) palette.
Hero Section Gradient Scrim: The hero_led_matrix image must have a vertical gradient scrim overlay (transparent at 0% -> surface at 100%) to ensure the Connect button and text have perfect contrast.
Connection Status Pill: Design a pill with a colored dot (success for Connected, warning for Scanning, error for Disconnected) and uppercase text. This lives prominently in the hero section.

Slider Component: Build or use a slider for Flight Tracking. The track is surfaceTertiary, fill is brandPrimary. Display the live value (e.g., '3 MI') prominently in Rajdhani next to or above the slider.
Text Input Styling: Inputs use surfaceTertiary background with no border. On focus, add a 1.5pt borderStrong outline. Labels must sit above the input, never floating.

Input Avatars / Logos: We attempted to fetch PNG logos for NYY, CAR, and Ted Lasso but standard searches returned stock photos instead of transparent graphics (original queries: 'New York Yankees logo transparent png', etc.). Use the Initials Avatar fallback for the leading visual inside these text inputs (e.g., a surfaceSecondary square box containing 'NY' in onSurface text). Keep the original queries noted in comments for future refetching.

Sticky Sync CTA: The 'Sync Settings' button must be fixed at the bottom of the screen (absolute position, background: surface, borderTop: divider). The ScrollView content must have enough bottom padding so it is not hidden by this sticky area.
Custom Toast: Implement a custom top or bottom toast for the 'Sync Settings' success message. Do not use default Alert. Use surfaceSecondary background with a success-colored icon.
No Emoji: Do not use emojis anywhere in the UI. Use Phosphor icons instead.
